== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Fall Back! (Japanese ESB Two-Player)|Fall Back!]] from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=100681 Star Wars Collectors Archive item 100681], [https://theswca.com/imgup/100681-1.jpg source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(90, 50, 680, 930)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>ba50ad57b8b830497e2d79c953b52c3c30cb16766dad738a069e19844984dd21</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
